Tooth of Laosaurus altus (now Dryosaurus) Marsh; front view

Bones of the left hind limb of Laosaurus altus (now Dryosaurus) Marsh; one eight natural size; il. ilium; is. ischium; p. pubis; p'. post-pubic bone; f. femur; I. tibia; f. fibula; a. astragalus; c. oalcaneum; I. first metatarsal; IVmt. fourth metatarsal.
